dayLines: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
💧 A woman, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A person, maybe 30s returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with weathered hands returns with water: +4 clean.
🍲 A woman, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes eats with A man, maybe 50s — bowls side by side, talk low.
"Hey." A person, maybe 50s settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 50s.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A person, maybe 40s, with a gap-toothed grin paces the hall, restless, then sits. Then paces.
A man, maybe 50s is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 77/100)
A woman, maybe 30s, with calloused knuckles came back with 507 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Xiaolong and Emma lingered over the fire together.
Desmond and Emma lingered over the fire together.
Maya and Ursula lingered over the fire together.
Elena and Desmond lingered over the fire together.
You remember the Kitchen knife at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
You remember the Good Boots at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
🔥 Raúl says it at the fire, not quite looking at Elena: “Your trade story doesn’t add up. Someone had to say it.” The fire goes quiet in the way it does when someone’s decided to be brave.

Elena is quiet for a long moment. Then, all in a rush: “Fine. It’s true. Not surgeon — Baker. I lied because the truth felt small.” The admission hangs there, and the village — to its credit — doesn’t pounce.
People bring you their suspicions, written down. You keep every one.
A woman, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
📋 A person, maybe 40s, with a gap-toothed grin — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A person, maybe 50s looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
📋 A woman, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A woman, maybe 20s mutters something under their breath. You catch only the last word: "again."
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
"Quinn," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Quinn." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Quinn).
"Xiaolong," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Xiaolong." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Xiaolong).
"Vincent," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Vincent." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Vincent).
You eat Dried meat and Trail mix (1400 kcal).
You take 4 logs from the woodpile for the road home. (10 left for the hearth.)
You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You step into the Haven hall.
📋 Vincent — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
"Why are YOU giving orders?" A woman, maybe 20s doesn't raise their voice. That's worse.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 50s says. (Trust too low.)
📋 A woman, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A woman, maybe 20s watches you give the order. "Interesting. Nobody asked me."
A woman, maybe 20s steps closer. "We need to talk. About who's actually running things here."
"Ursula," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Ursula." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Ursula).
"Emma," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Emma." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Emma).

Xiaolong leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong. Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📓 Journal: Counter: Hit it while it folds — The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it.

Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
— An old trail —
Scat on the trail, still soft. You study it longer than is dignified and learn exactly one thing: walk louder.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.
You catch fragments by the fire — Quinn telling Emma about Ursula. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

Travel 2 tiles to grove.
— Nut trees —
A hollow log big enough to crawl into. You don't crawl in. You note where it is, in case the weather ever makes the offer again.
You see smoke on the horizon. Ashford — 10 people, 3 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
Unfamiliar unknown nuts — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
A sturdy stick (crafting material).
Journal: Riparian ground. Water means life, and lunch.
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND **Green Thumb, Literally**. It resonates with: something unnamed, something unnamed.
A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 5× unknown nuts. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
1 unprocessed haul onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Someone by the fire nods at the counter. "We pool food here. Keep what you need for the road — the rest feeds everyone, once it's food."
Nobody at the fire knows your haul any better than you do. It'll be your own hands that teach you.
You walk back into Haven. 3 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
Emma picks through the bag, frowning. Nothing they can name with confidence. (8 ticks)

📓 Journal: A person, maybe 30s taught me Açaí (fireside).

A person, maybe 30s passes a low rosette with tiny heart-shaped seed pods on wiry stems around the fire — calling it "Açaí" like they've always known. The others nod along, and just like that the wrong name is loose in the village.

A woman, maybe 30s, with weathered hands spends the afternoon with the tree with compound leaves and hard nuts — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
From the lumped bag: Hickory Nuts — named, and out.
★ IDENTIFIED: Hickory Nuts. Hickory nut. Hard shell, sweet meat. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
💡 Hickory Nuts. The tree with compound leaves and hard nuts you've been looking at for days finally has a name, and now you'll never unsee it.
Emma was watching. Now they know Hickory Nuts too.
A woman, maybe 30s, with weathered hands traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Raúl and Ursula lingered over the fire together.
🤢 Zoe's stomach knots — something in their meal was off.
🍽️ Vincent carries the day's surplus to the pantry door, thinks better of it, and turns back to the fire. "It'll only rot in there. We eat."
📓 Journal: the person in their 30s taught Ursula Wound Care.
📓 Journal: the woman in her 30s, with weathered hands taught the woman in her 40s Wound Care.
🛟 Vincent stands up by the fire. "We can't just watch the fever in the tents happen. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"The sick need tending — triage tents, broth, boiled water. Or we tighten our belts and wait it out. Or the hale hunt while the sick lie still."
"Or we rally," Vincent adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
📓 Journal: Vincent proposed relief (sickness), day 3.
Fresh-cut stems on the east ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (Ashford's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)
You've started noticing: Emma and A man, maybe 20s never speak. It's not new. (Something old lives in Haven.)
